stale_model_protection.description: Joblib artifact older than MAX_MODEL_AGE_HOURS (72h) forces observe-only
stale_model_protection.behavior: When stale=True, boot receipt ready=False, decide() returns NO_TRADE with MODEL_STALE_OBSERVE_ONLY reason

feature_health_weighting.description: Strategist confidence clamped by feature health score
feature_health_weighting.behavior: If health < 0.3, force NO_TRADE with STRATEGIST_FEATURE_HEALTH_LOW reason

executor_heartbeat.description: Per-lane pipeline heartbeat surfaces frozen lanes
executor_heartbeat.frozen_heuristic: No run in > FREEZE_AFTER_MIN (15) OR (signals=0 AND avg_health < 0.3)

admin_auth_gate.description: All admin endpoints require admin role
